verdict.rationale: Undermind's MCP tools support deep literature review with self-planned search, full-text PDF analysis across many papers in parallel, and synthesis/citation-linked notes, which covers much of a screening-and-extraction workflow (undermind-docs-4, undermind-docs-5, undermind-docs-6). However, it is framed around open-ended research goals rather than explicit user-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria for systematic review, and community feedback notes incomplete coverage (missing gray literature, dissertations) and confusing 'exhaustiveness' metrics that undercut consistency guarantees (undermind-comm-1, undermind-comm-4, undermind-comm-19). Missing for 10: explicit support for defined screening criteria/PRISMA-style workflows, evidence of consistent extraction accuracy validated across large batches, and independent benchmarking of completeness.
